fit.method: globally constrained final-surface biharmonic fit with convex transverse rows and complete C2 side arc

side_curve.projection_role: unapproved Test 1 magnitude held as an experimental control, not reference evidence
side_curve.objective: integrated squared change of second derivative along the complete side arc
side_curve.representation: one fifth-degree B-spline, no two-span crest or literal magenta fit

fit.symmetry_note: One connected surface solve; no separate left/right anterior objects
